notes.title: Super Tony Land is now in Beta!
notes.content:
Wow, thanks for your patience waiting for this update. Here’s a list of additions, changes and fixes:

[b]Blocks:[/b]
Core Block
Chain Platform
Shadow Block
45d Ramp
Fire Block

[b]Monsters[/b]
Floating Skull
Floating Dummy Head
Koi (fishman)
Super Gamekid
Normish Kami
Normish Knight

[b]Tronics[/b]
Tronic Gravity
Tronic Coin
Tronic OnScreen
Tronic Power
Tronic Function and Function Call

[b]Items[/b]
Bubbles
Bullet
Giant Fireball
Meeple
Pie

[b]Powerups[/b]
PieMaster powerup
Star Hat powerup
Taco powerup

[b]Other Stuff[/b]
Added a Boss power meter for boss fights
Tronic NPC added Vanish
Tronic Color changes to match type
Major Chain fix
Audio Video Menu merge
Added volume control
Added a bunch of Kickstarter Content!

notes.title: We've Launched in Early Access!
notes.content:
Today we've launched Super Tony Land in early access! 

We've been working on a ton of bug fixes and improvements lately, a bunch which were found while showing the game at PAX East. Just before PAX, we added Co-Op, and it was great watching people play together there.

Next on our list of things to add is some of the crazy content from our Kickstarter backers. We'll be streaming development later today (and fairly often) over on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/robotloveskitty]twitch channel[/url], so give us a follow and come hang out. :robotloveskitty:
